v = app.actions.run('view.envs')
assert v['copies'] > 0 and v['copies'] % 3 == 0, v

import time, numpy as np, nuka
def frames(n):
    for _ in range(n):
        app.update(True)
hips = [j for j in app.actions.run('robot.joints')['joints'] if 'hip' in j['name']]
assert len(hips) == 4, [j['name'] for j in hips]
for e, value in ((1, 0.4), (2, -0.4)):
    app.actions.run('view.envs', current=e)
    frames(3)
    app.actions.run('robot.set_targets', targets={j['name']: value for j in hips})
    frames(3)
app.actions.run('view.envs', current=0)
frames(3)
app.actions.run('sim.step', steps=120)
deadline = time.monotonic() + 60.0
while app.actions.run('timeline.status')['tick'] < 120:
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline
    app.update(True)
frames(5)
dt = np.asarray(app.world.download_field(nuka.Field.DRIVE_TARGET), dtype=np.float32).reshape(16, -1)
for j in hips:
    l = j['link']
    assert abs(dt[1, l] - 0.4) < 1e-6 and abs(dt[2, l] + 0.4) < 1e-6 and dt[0, l] == dt[3, l] and abs(dt[0, l]) < 0.39, (j['name'], dt[:4, l])
p = np.asarray(app.world.download_field(nuka.Field.ARTICULATION_LINK_POSE), dtype=np.float32).reshape(16, -1, 7)
assert not np.allclose(p[1], p[0], atol=1e-3) and not np.allclose(p[2], p[0], atol=1e-3) and np.allclose(p[3], p[0], atol=1e-6), 'per-env poses'
q = np.asarray(app.world.download_field(nuka.Field.JOINT_POSITION), dtype=np.float32).reshape(16, -1)
for e in (2, 1, 0):
    app.actions.run('view.envs', current=e)
    frames(4)
    v = app.actions.run('robot.joints')
    assert v['env'] == e, v['env']
    for j in v['joints']:
        assert abs(j['q'] - q[e, j['link']]) < 1e-4 and abs(j['target'] - dt[e, j['link']]) < 1e-6, (e, j['name'], j['q'], q[e, j['link']])
print('ENVS per-env targets, poses and joints ok')

import time, builtins, numpy as np
end = time.monotonic() + 8.5
while time.monotonic() < end:
    app.update(True)
def frame_grid():
    v = app.actions.run('view.envs')
    o = np.array([c['offset'] for c in v['cells']])
    c = (o.min(axis=0) + o.max(axis=0)) * 0.5
    span = float(np.max(o.max(axis=0) - o.min(axis=0))) + 1.0
    app.actions.run('view.camera', target=[float(c[0]), float(c[1]), 0.4], distance=2.2 * span, yaw=240.0, pitch=32.0)
builtins.frame_grid = frame_grid
frame_grid()
